signing.note: Host-trusted development signer (design L.1 item 22); not an installation identity.

layout.note: NTFS names are case-insensitive: the CLI cannot sit beside ArkDeck.exe. The App's daemon is its sibling by default; the CLI is given ARKDECK_DAEMON_PATH.

daemonConfiguration.ARKDECK_DAEMON_PATH: the App: unset (arkdeck-agentd.exe beside ArkDeck.exe); the CLI: <install>\arkdeck-agentd.exe
